texts.bp_handed: Umuntu uzokushayela noma akubhalele. Inombolo yecala lakho ithi {case}.
texts.bp_link_sent: Sikuthumelele isixhumanisi nge-SMS. Sivule ocingweni olune-inthanethi.
texts.bp_locked: Ama-PIN angalungile mangaphezu kwalokho. I-akhawunti yakho ikhiyiwe, akukho okususiwe. Yibuyise ku-inthanethi noma ubuze umnikazi.
texts.bp_new_pin: Khetha i-PIN yezinombolo ezi-4 kuya kwezi-8:
texts.bp_pin_help: I-PIN yesisebenzi isethwa kabusha kudivayisi ngumnikazi noma umphathi. Eyomnikazi ngokubuyisa ku-inthanethi kuphela.
texts.bp_read_more: Shayela imenyu ye-LynkOmni bese ukhetha Imilayezo ukuze ufunde okwengeziwe.
texts.bp_recovery: Bhala phansi ikhodi yakho yokubuyisa futhi uyigcine iphephile: {code}
texts.bp_star_hint: Cindezela * ukuze uthayiphe igama lesibonelo elithi {name}
texts.bp_terms: Uyavumelana nemigomo yokusebenzisa nesaziso semfihlo ku-lynkomni.com/legal?
texts.bp_too_young: Kufanele ube neminyaka engu-{age} noma ngaphezulu ukuze ube ne-akhawunti.
texts.bp_username: Khetha igama lomsebenzisi (izinhlamvu, izinombolo, . kanye no-_):
texts.bp_wrong_pin: I-PIN ayilungile. Kusele imizamo engu-{left} ngaphambi kokukhiywa.
texts.ch_no_command: Akuwona umyalo. Thumela u-4 ukuze uthole usizo.
texts.ch_sandbox: Isibonelo (ukuhlola): ayikho ikhodi noma inombolo yangempela kuze kusayinwe isango ezweni lakho.
texts.title: I-LynkPOS efonini enezinkinobho
